name: Sign Out
summary: Ends the current authenticated client session and returns the user to an anonymous authentication state.

sourceReferences.note: The existing web logoff endpoint terminates the ASP.NET Identity sign-in session and records UserLogout.
RevokeRefreshTokenAsync provides the server primitive needed to terminate the current token-backed mobile session without revoking every device.
React Native currently clears only local session state during sign-out; server refresh-token revocation remains to be normalized.
